records.title: Shimla Smart City Project
details: a to c: Post the financial closure of SCM on 31st March, 2025, Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA) has issued Advisory No 27 dated 10th June, 2025 to all States/ UTs. The ongoing projects are in different stages of implementation. The SPVs have been advised to ensure that all their ongoing projects under SCM are completed not later than December, 2025

records.title: OBJECTIVES OF GREEN STEEL TAXONOMY
details:
(a)to(d): The objectives of Green Steel Taxonomy is to define the ‘Green Steel’
and to develop a framework for encouraging steel industries to produce green steel,
by adopting energy efficient technology and non-fossil fuel, for example, renewable
energy etc. It was finalized after having series of consultations and deliberations with
various stakeholders. Green Steel Certificates will be issued to those plants whoever
apply and meet the emission intensity level as per Taxonomy of Green Steel. National
Institute of Secondary Steel Technology (NISST), a training institute under Ministry of
Steel, is the nodal agency for Measurement, Reporting, and Verification (MRV) as well
as for issuing green steel certificates and star ratings for steel. Till now, 39 iron and
steel producers have applied for green steel certificates.

records.title: PROMOTION OF TOURISM IN SHIMLA.
details:
a to b: the Ministry of Tourism has sanctioned a project around Shimla named "Development of Himalayan Circuit: Kiarighat, Shimla, Hatkoti, Manali, Kangra, Dharamshala, Bir, Palampur, Chamba" at a cost of Rs. 68.34 crore.
(c): The Ministry of Tourism has identified the project 'Development Of Maa Chintpurni Temple, Una District' under the PRASHAD Scheme. The major components proposed in the project includes Q-Complex with Pilgrimage Facilities for Darshan, LED Façade Illumination for Q-Complex and Covered pathway at Temple Level, etc.
